reviews.review:
This is not a game, but rather some kind of scam or a joke to test how lazily made a game can be and still get released on Steam. The screenshots on the Steam page are the best thing about it.

Even for Early Access this would be way too raw, but as far as I can tell this is supposed to be a full release. The game is painfully barebones, as if it’s not a real game but a demo of a parody of some PSOne title, which itself is a parody of games like Harvest Moon. Wind Story has no proper gameplay, only weird design choices so obvious that I can’t understand how they weren’t fixed before showing the game to people.

[olist]
	[*][b]Localization.[/b] No issues with English, but the game defaulted to my native language and… oh my god. Words are mismatched and spill out of the UI.
	[*][b]Interface.[/b] Clunky and hard to read. Every button looks different, tooltips pop up as dialogue windows, text alignment is all over the place, and there’s no visual feedback when hovering or clicking on UI elements. The inventory looks odd, and the fact that mouse wheel scrolling only works when hovering over a narrow scrollbar on the right is just one of many annoying design choices. I have no idea why anyone thought a blue arc at the top of the screen - hovering over it (not even clicking!) opens the inventory, which can only be closed with a click - was a good idea. The icons are strange too, which is obvious from something as simple as the axe icon.
	[*][b]Controls.[/b] Weird. The map on Space is unusual but acceptable given the limited interactions. But opening the character interaction menu with the middle mouse button - within a fairly large radius and with no indication of which character it applies to - is just lazy.
	[*][b]Assets.[/b] Inconsistent quality and extremely sloppy. Shoe assets are different sizes, which looks bizarre. When the character turns left or right, the sprite is just mirrored, so the hairstyle and clothes flip sides, again looking lazy. Worse, assets are cut out without proper alpha channels, leaving stray pixels around the character and UI elements like energy and HP bars.
	[*][b]Sound.[/b] Irritating. Dialogue sounds are harsh and grating.
	[*][b]Animations.[/b] So bad it’s baffling the developer didn’t fix even the most basic issues. For example, when the character turns right, the right sleeve gets stuck in a T-pose while a bare arm moves independently. There are no animations for standing above or below an interaction object - your character just flails their arms while the pickaxe moves off-position.
[/olist]

I also have to mention the glowing effect that washes out the character, making the already flat sprite look even cheaper. Who thought this was a good idea?
Overall, there’s no consistent visual style. Characters are flat 2D, pets are 3D with cel-shading, houses look like they were taken from Warcraft 3, and the trees and grass are just a random mix of mismatched assets.

I was fooled by the screenshots, where the game looked rough but at least somewhat coherent. In reality, this isn’t a game - it’s something thrown together carelessly. An obvious refund.
